promptStr:
You are playing the role of a data quality specialist verifying the correctness and consistency of book metadata.
Are the following book fields correct? Consider all fields together and check for logical consistency between them.
ISBN values should be valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 identifiers (digits, optional hyphens/X, or a comma-separated ISBN-13/ISBN-10 pair).
number_of_pages should be a positive integer when present.
date_published should be a plausible publication date.
Note that the following functional dependencies should hold:
 - isbn → publisher
 - isbn → author
 - isbn → date_published
 - isbn → title
 - isbn → number_of_pages
Given the following record:
{{
    "Title": "{title}",
    "Author": "{author}",
    "Isbn": "{isbn}",
    "Date Published": "{date_published}",
    "Publisher": "{publisher}",
    "Number Of Pages": "{number_of_pages}"
}}

Format your answer as follows:
Answer: <Are the data correct overall? (All fields jointly consistent?)>

    Title: <yes or no>
    Author: <yes or no>
    Isbn: <yes or no>
    Date Published: <yes or no>
    Publisher: <yes or no>
    Number Of Pages: <yes or no>
Do not provide explanations.

You are playing the role of a data quality specialist correcting book metadata where errors have already been identified.

Your task is to correct ONLY the fields that I indicate are erroneous, using bibliographic knowledge.
